# Borrowed numbering (self-test decoy)

A runbook that adopts another document's section space in its opening line
(architecture §3.2) and then uses bare references throughout, which is how the real
runbooks in this repository are written.

The message contract is §3.2 and the dead-letter path is §3.4. Both resolve in the
document named above, so neither is a finding.
